text:
Morgan: Quick async check-in re: SDK quickstarts + sample app packaging. TL;DR: landed most docs edits, sample app builds but mac wheel failing in CI. What I did / blockers / today
Sam: Nice. +1 on the docs. I skimmed the quickstart and left a couple inline comments on the phrasing. PR is ready for review (https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/842)
Li: Thanks — saw those comments. I can take the PR review after lunch. FYI the sample app now uses the new streaming example for chat, so the README changed a bit.
Anika: Blocker: CI mac wheel failing with "ERROR: ld: symbol(s) not found" during build-wheel step. Looks like a macOS linker issue in the native extension. Trying to reproduce locally on an M1 box. If anyone has a mac build clue, ping me.
Jordan: I hit that locally too, specifically when building against python 3.11 + arm64. Workaround was to force universal2 wheel in the build config, but that felt like a bandaid. Will try the build flags today and open an issue.
Eva: I can allocate a cloud mac runner for a repro. @Anika want me to spin one up and share SSH? :thumbsup:
Anika: Yes please @Eva — that'd help. If you can also attach the full build log that would speed diagnosis.
docbot: Reminder: docs lint job failed on main earlier — model quickstart code block needs triple-backtick fencing with language label. See https://docs.redwood.ai/ci/docs-lint for format.
Morgan: Noted — I'll patch the code block in the quickstart to ```bash and also update the sample readme to show the streaming snippet with minimal scaffolding.
Sam: Quick question: should the sample app use the hosted API example or the local private stack example? My vote is hosted for first-run simplicity, with a short note about Dedicated/Private for production.
Li: Agreed — hosted by default, add a short section "Production: Dedicated/Private" with a snippet of the routing config. I can draft that.
Jordan: FYI I opened an issue for wheel failures: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/issues/1280. I'll drop the build flags and the minimal reproducer there.
Eva: Done — mac runner up at mac-ci-07, user: devex-debug.ssh key in the shared secrets vault. @Anika check channel for details.
Anika: Reproduced on mac-ci-07. Root cause looks like we link against a non-existent symbol in the C-extension when LTO is enabled. Short-term: disable LTO for the wheel build. Pushing a small CI patch now.
Sam: Great. Once CI green, I'll merge PR #842 and update the release notes for the sample app.
Morgan: Today I'm finishing the docs patch, coordinating the CI fix, and doing a quick smoke test of the sample app on hosted. If anyone wants to pair on release notes, ping me.
Jordan: I'll follow up later with the universal2 vs disable-LTO tradeoffs in the issue, and add a test target for mac-arm in CI matrix.
Eva: I'll clean up the runner and remove SSH key after Anika confirms.
docbot: CI update: mac wheel job failed 3x, retry queued.
ci-bot: Build #4217 started on mac-ci-07 for branch fix/disable-lto.
Sam: Thanks all. Nothing blocking from my side after CI green. :rocket:
Morgan: Awesome — will post a short summary here once merged. Cheers!
